### Encouragement for Today - January 25, 2006: Specks (Part 1)
Author: Susanne Scheppmann
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-25-2006-1374938.html
Passage: John 9:25
Points:
- A painful mishap with a contact lens highlighted how easily people take clear physical vision for granted.
- Spiritual blindness is a pervasive affliction that believers and unbelievers often fail to recognize in themselves.
- Jesus specializes in curing both physical and spiritual sight, leading individuals from darkness into worship and belief.
- Temporary earthly troubles cannot extinguish the light of Christ once He opens a person's spiritual eyes.

### This is My Story and I’m Sticking To It - Girlfriends in God - September 17, 2014
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/this-is-my-story-and-i-m-sticking-to-it-girlfriends-in-god-september-17-2014.html
Passage: John 9:25
Points:
- The man healed of blindness stood unwavering before interrogating religious leaders by simply recounting his experience.
- While critics may argue over theological minutiae, a genuine personal testimony of Christ's work is irrefutable.
- Shared life stories bridge relational gaps and speak far more powerfully to seekers than abstract debates.
- Unplanned hardships and trials serve as the canvas upon which God reveals His healing grace.

### Encouragement 10-06-04: I Was Blind But Now I See
Author: Ginger Plowman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-10-06-04-1287138.html
Passage: John 9:25
Points:
- Rigid personal standards and critical judgments blinded the author to another Christian's authentic expression of faith.
- Hearing a former outcast testify to God's redeeming power brought conviction and healed judgmental blindness.
- Deep gratitude for the Lord's deliverance naturally produces passionate, unashamed praise.
- True spiritual sight requires viewing others through Christ's compassion rather than self-righteous scrutiny.

### When You Need to See Clearly - Crosswalk Couples Devotional - June 13
Author: Rebecca Barlow Jordan
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/crosswalk-couples-devotional-june-11.html
Passage: John 9:25
Points:
- Cataract surgery provided a stark picture of how subtly poor vision develops and how miraculous restored clarity feels.
- In relationships, routine pressures and self-centeredness can gradually cloud how spouses view one another.
- Couples need the Lord to cut through distorted perceptions and replace them with grace.
- Viewing a spouse through God's perspective restores mutual honor, forgiveness, and clear spiritual sight.
